slides.h: Sargent painted this a few minutes at a time, only at *dusk*

slides.label: England, 1885

slides.b: So he painted only then.

slides.h: He set up his easel before the light *came*
slides.b: Two girls, paper lanterns, lilies.

slides.h: When the flowers died, he used *fake* ones
slides.b: He finished the next year.

slides.h: Carnation, Lily, Lily, *Rose*

slides.h: Goya painted his darkest visions on the walls of his own *house*
At 72, Goya moved outside *Madrid*
slides.b: Deaf, and living alone.

slides.h: The house was known as the Deaf Man's *Villa*
slides.b: The Quinta del Sordo.

slides.h: He painted *14 murals* on its walls
slides.b: Today called the Black Paintings.

slides.h: The walls were moved onto *canvas*
slides.b: They hang in the Prado today.

slides.h: Every wall tells a story. Choose *yours*
slides.b: Framed canvas art, printed one at a time for your walls.
